capabilities: Embed kanban boards in notes as fenced code blocks
Define custom card fields (text, date, number, select, file) per board
Drag cards across columns and swimlanes with workflow validation
Generate boards via AI coding agents using a provided skill
extras: Boards remain readable as plain Markdown tables even without the plugin installed; an installable skill lets 75+ AI agents write valid board blocks directly into notes.
intentEvidence: I kept bouncing off every kanban plugin I tried.
motivation: The author kept bouncing off every kanban plugin they tried because boards were cut off from the note and the UI felt outdated, so they built their own.
problem: Existing kanban plugins live in separate tabs, disconnected from the note being worked on, with limited card data and dated UI.

relations.evidence: Import from Obsidian Kanban — bring existing obsidian-kanban boards over with one command
you can install the Fancy Kanban skill and ask it to generate boards

requires.name: agentic AI coding tool (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Pi, or similar)

summary: Kanban board plugin that embeds boards directly in notes as fenced code blocks with custom card fields, drag-and-drop, swimlanes, and workflow validation.
